property_summary: For any EOA actor that deposits a positive amount, the first withdrawAll succeeds and clears the credit, so a subsequent withdrawAll from that actor must be a successful no-op (revert-free); the mutant keeps credit equal to oCredit, so the second withdrawAll underflows balance and reverts.
change_summary: Replace 'credit[msg.sender]=0;' with 'credit[msg.sender]=oCredit;' so the credit is not cleared but reset to the same value.
